record.paper_title: NLS ground states on metric trees: existence results and open questions
record.context_brief: Existence at the non-radial threshold mass for p = 4
record.original_question: For the nonlinear Schrödinger ground-state minimization problem on the rooted binary metric tree T_o or unrooted binary metric tree T at the exponent p = 4, with threshold μ_G^* = max{μ ≥ 0: L_G(μ) = (1/2)λ_1 μ}, do ground states of mass μ = μ_G^* exist?

evidence.quote: Assume G = T (or G = T_o) and p ∈ (2,6), and define μ_G^* := max { μ ≥ 0 : L_G(μ) = 1/2 λ_1 μ }.
Finally, when p = 4, we do not know whether ground states exist or not, with a mass μ = μ_G^*.

artifact.category_tag: NLS ground states on metric graphs
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be either the rooted infinite binary metric tree $T_o$ (an infinite metric graph in which the root vertex has degree 1 and every other vertex has degree 3, with all edges of unit length) or the unrooted infinite binary metric tree $T$ (every vertex has degree 3, with unit-length edges). Functions on $G$ are defined edgewise, and $H^1(G)$ denotes the space of continuous functions on $G$ whose edgewise weak derivatives are square-integrable.

For $p \in (2,6)$ and a mass $\mu > 0$, consider the constrained minimization problem
$$L_G(\mu) := \inf\Big\{ E(u,G) : u \in H^1(G),\ \|u\|_{L^2(G)}^2 = \mu \Big\},$$
where the NLS energy is
$$E(u,G) := \tfrac{1}{2}\int_G |u'|^2\,dx - \tfrac{1}{p}\int_G |u|^p\,dx.$$
A function attaining the infimum (when finite and attained) is called a ground state of mass $\mu$.

Let $\lambda_1 = \lambda_1(G) > 0$ denote the bottom of the spectrum of the (Neumann/Kirchhoff) Laplacian on $G$, and define the threshold
$$\mu_G^* := \max\Big\{ \mu \geq 0 : L_G(\mu) = \tfrac{1}{2}\lambda_1\, \mu \Big\}.$$

Question: For the critical exponent $p = 4$, does there exist a ground state of mass $\mu = \mu_G^*$ on $G = T$ and on $G = T_o$?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches turned up the original 2020 publication stating this as an open problem and several follow-up works on NLS ground states on metric graphs (including doubly nonlinear extensions and nonuniqueness results), but none explicitly resolve the existence/non-existence of ground states at the threshold mass $\mu_G^*$ for $p=4$ on the binary metric tree. Status appears unresolved.

status_evidence.title: NLS ground states on metric trees: existence results and open questions
status_evidence.snippet: Considers minimization of NLS energy on metric tree with mass constraint; raises threshold phenomena questions.
status_evidence.claim: Original formulation lists the p=4 threshold-mass existence as an open question.

status_evidence.title: Doubly nonlinear Schrödinger ground states on metric graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Follow-up work on metric graph ground states; does not resolve p=4 threshold case on binary trees.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution of the specific p=4 threshold-mass question is reported in subsequent literature found.

status_evidence.title: Nonuniqueness of normalized ground states for NLS on metric graphs (2025)
status_evidence.snippet: Nonuniqueness results on metric graphs but not addressing the p=4 threshold-mass existence on binary trees.
status_evidence.claim: Recent related literature does not appear to settle the question.
